title.value: Neuroplastic Expansion in Deep Reinforcement Learning
title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the top of the paper and is referenced multiple times throughout the paper, specifically focusing on Neuroplastic Expansion in the context of deep reinforcement learning.
title.quote: NEUROPLASTIC EXPANSION IN DEEP REINFORCEMENT LEARNING

analysis.description: This paper introduces a novel method called Neuroplastic Expansion (NE), which aims to address plasticity loss in deep reinforcement learning by dynamically growing the network from a smaller initial size to its full dimension. The paper outlines three key components: elastic topology generation, dormant neuron pruning, and neuron consolidation via experience review. The experimental results demonstrate that NE effectively mitigates plasticity loss and outperforms state-of-the-art methods across various tasks.

type.justification: The study involves extensive experiments demonstrating the application and effectiveness of the proposed Neuroplastic Expansion method across various tasks, indicating an empirical approach.
type.quote: Extensive experiments demonstrate that NE effectively mitigates plasticity loss and outperforms state-of-the-art methods across various tasks in MuJoCo and DeepMind Control Suite environments.

name.justification: The paper focuses on addressing challenges and improving learning mechanisms in deep reinforcement learning, as evidenced by discussions on methods, environments used for testing, and the core problem of plasticity in deep RL.
name.quote: The loss of plasticity in learning agents, analogous to the solidification of neural pathways in biological brains, significantly impedes learning and adaptation in reinforcement learning due to its non-stationary nature.

name.justification: The paper draws inspiration from biological processes, particularly cortical expansion in cognitive science, to address challenges in neural network design and optimization.
name.quote: Drawing inspiration from this biological mechanism, we propose a novel perspective – Neuroplastic Expansion, which can help maintain plasticity in deep RL.

name.justification: Neuroplastic Expansion is introduced and extensively discussed as a novel method proposed by the authors to maintain plasticity in deep reinforcement learning.
name.quote: To address this fundamental challenge, we propose a novel approach, Neuroplastic Expansion (NE), inspired by cortical expansion in cognitive science.

is_contributed.justification: The model is a central contribution of the paper, specifically developed to address the problem of plasticity loss in deep reinforcement learning.
is_contributed.quote: We introduce a novel mechanism, Neuroplastic Expansion (NE), to mitigate the loss of plasticity in deep RL.
